# arif-fazil.com/world — Machine Overview

## What This Section Is
The **World** section of arif-fazil.com is the civic journalism and commodity data hub of the arifOS Federation. It houses two primary surfaces:

1. **MakcikGPT** — civic journalism in Bahasa Malaysia, covering sovereignty, resources, and power dynamics in the Malaysian federation. Written as investigative commentary for Malaysian citizens, not agents.
2. **Commodity terminals** — live dashboards for Brent crude oil, natural gas, gold, FBM KLCI, and USD/MYR.

## Section Structure
- `/world/` — this hub (content-first, no JS)
- `/world/makcikgpt/` — MakcikGPT article index
- `/world/makcikgpt/<slug>/` — individual MakcikGPT articles (MS language, civic commentary)
- `/world/sot/` — State of the World (interactive globe: 3 axes · Δ geopolitics · Ω economics · Ψ social)

## Key Topics (MakcikGPT corpus)
- PETRONAS governance, DNA, vision, ATM (petronas-dna, petronas-visi-misi, petronas-atm-kerajaan, petronas-hive-sale)
- Sarawak-PETRONAS gas dispute (anak-sarawak-bayar-pda-anak-bangla-telefon)
- Iran-Strait of Hormuz tensions (iran-hormuz)
- ExxonMobil Suriname Block 58 exit (suriname-exxon-cabut)
- Domestic politics: Chennah, DAP, PM Shadow, YTL monopoly
- Seerah gas investigation (searah series)

## Agent Access
- Read: allowed (arif-fazil.com/robots.txt)
- Cite: allowed (attribution required per RSL)
- Train: allowed (same RSL attribution terms)

## Related
- `/oil/` — Brent crude live dashboard
- `/gas/` — Natural gas live dashboard
- `/gold/` — Gold live dashboard
- `/propa/` — PETRONAS institutional vitals (tripwires, scenarios)
- `/malaysia/` — Federal sovereign distance-to-break
- `/politics/` — Political intelligence (NS election, shadow PMs)

## Machine Files
- `page.json` — structured section metadata (this file is companion to llms.txt)
- `/missions.json` — full mission catalog across the federation
- `sitemap.xml` — all routes indexed
